definitions.explanation: To change the scheduled time of a meeting, appointment, or event. Common business slang abbreviated from リスケジュール (reschedule).

examples.japanese: ⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧リスケ⟦しても→する：00392_suru⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
⟦{急|きゅう}な→急：13042_kyuu⟧⟦{予定|よてい}→予定：00824_yotei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{入|はい}った→入る：00494_hairu⟧⟦ので→ので：09501_node⟧、リスケ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦お{願|ねが}いしたい→願う：02387_negau⟧。
examples.english: Something urgent came up, so I'd like to ask to reschedule.

examples.japanese: ⟦{明日|あした}→明日：00501_ashita⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{打|う}ち{合|あ}わせ→打ち合わせ：07155_uchiawase⟧、リスケ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なりました→なる：01970_naru⟧。

notes:
FORMS:
リスケ is clipped from リスケジュール (reschedule), following the standard Japanese pattern of cutting a loanword to about four moras.

USAGE:
- リスケ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to reschedule)
- リスケ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧ (to be rescheduled - the usual way to report it, since the decision is treated as coming from the situation rather than from a person)
- リスケ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦お{願|ねが}いする→願う：02387_negau⟧ (to request a reschedule)
Note that リスケ means moving an appointment to a different time, not cancelling it. In finance the same word is also used for restructuring a loan repayment schedule.

REGISTER:
Casual in-house business slang - fine in a chat message or among colleagues, out of place in a letter to a client. More formal alternatives:
- ⟦{日程|にってい}→日程：04289_nittei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{変更|へんこう}する→変更：03616_henkou⟧ (to change the schedule)
- ⟦{予定|よてい}→予定：00824_yotei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{調整|ちょうせい}する→調整：14839_chousei⟧ (to adjust the schedule)
- ⟦{延期|えんき}する→延期：01888_enki⟧ (to postpone - only when the new time is later)

SIMILAR ABBREVIATIONS:
- ⟦アポ→アポ：06668_apo⟧ (appointment - from アポイントメント)
- ⟦プレゼン→プレゼン：05505_purezen⟧ (presentation - from プレゼンテーション)
